components.notes: Qualified application binding. 0.4.1 (echelon-current 1.28.0) adds print styles and the Forma icon-print tools to 0.4.0 and declares no runtime dependencies; 0.4.0 stays qualified as its upgrade source.

Qualified application binding. 0.10.0 (echelon-current 1.30.0; LCE-001 layout constraint enforcement), 0.11.0 (echelon-current 1.32.0; opt-in typography roles for application, dense and accessible type scales, with the package exports, files, bin and license unchanged from 0.10.0), 0.12.0 (echelon-current 1.33.0; stricter workflow-diagram validation, A11Y-NONTEXT-CONTRAST, and the additive token:status-* workflow colour tokens, with the package exports, files, bin and license unchanged from 0.11.0) and 0.13.0 (echelon-current 1.34.0, which the indy-init preset follows; layout reliability, LRP-001: an unbreakable token now wraps inside Forma containers, and the package ships the F# design-token validator source, tools/TokenValidator, with the package exports, bin and license unchanged from 0.12.0) are exact GitHub release-asset pins; the default stays 0.5.0.

Qualified application binding. 1.2.0 is the npm registry release @echelon-foundry/forma-workflow@1.2.0 (tarball https://registry.npmjs.org/@echelon-foundry/forma-workflow/-/forma-workflow-1.2.0.tgz, integrity sha512-6xopcnEOFN/3n9ItU6V+YLFdWzekDGlKjDxFdyGe4mJz15ZId3G505zNWY2gv+MwAuixZZRUHVQW13mvSAUERw==, license PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0, published from kemiller2002/forma packages/workflow), the Forma workflow layout engine; it declares no runtime dependencies and the peer dependency @echelon-foundry/design-system >=0.4.0, so a manifest that declares it must declare Forma 0.4.1 or later. It does not depend on Limen.

Qualified project-bound WASM/browser package used by the current web scaffold; Conditor does not run a package-manager lifecycle for it. 0.7.0, 0.7.1, 0.9.0 (the default; it adds the routing / URL-state module) and 0.9.1 (echelon-current 1.31.0; it stamps the package version into the browser-kernel build and ships the limen wasm-check command, with no change to the source, the protocol or the routing module) are distributed as @echelon-foundry/limen; 0.6.1 and 0.6.2 stay qualified under their original @echelon-foundry/typescript-wasm-kernel name, and the Indy Init 0.1.0 freeze pins 0.6.2.

Native Ordo 1.4.0 is the Registry Indy Init 0.1.0 freeze baseline; the indy-init preset follows echelon-current; 1.4.1 stays qualified as an upgrade source; 1.4.2 (echelon-current 1.1.0) and 1.5.0 (echelon-current 1.2.0) are qualified with the integrity-only gate, which fails closed on installation integrity and records SDE-STRUCT-001 structural review signals instead of refusing on them; 1.6.0, 1.7.0, 1.8.2 (echelon-current 1.24.0, the Ordo Praxis 3.13.0 pins; stamp-only for repositories) 1.17.0 (echelon-current 1.25.0, the contract admission and readiness Praxis 3.16.0 mirrors; stamp-only for repositories, straight from 1.8.2), 1.18.0 (echelon-current 1.29.0; adds sde verification schedule over an admitted verification plan, with no change to the lifecycle commands or the installed .sde payload; stamp-only for repositories), 1.19.0 (echelon-current 1.31.0; sde verification schedule binds evidence freshness per policy and per obligation acceptance contract, with no change to the lifecycle commands or the installed .sde payload; stamp-only for repositories) and 1.20.0 (echelon-current 1.34.0, which the indy-init preset follows; opt-in ordo.decision-event/1 decision events, ecir recognize --events or ORDO_DECISION_EVENTS and the ordo events commands, with no change to the lifecycle commands, the verify report or the installed .sde payload; stamp-only for repositories) are qualified through the same gate.
Native Percepta repository lifecycle 0.1.0 is the frozen Indy Init repository-lifecycle baseline.

Native Praxis 3.6.0 is the Registry Indy Init 0.1.0 freeze baseline; 3.7.1 and 3.7.2 are qualified, 3.10.0 (echelon-current 1.16.0), 3.11.0 (echelon-current 1.17.0), 3.12.0 (echelon-current 1.23.0; the first release whose validator accepts an interrupted-predecessor finalization), 3.14.0 (atomic work claims, verified completion and Ordo contract admission, with release.json compatibility state schemas unchanged from 3.12.0), 3.16.0 (echelon-current 1.25.0; verified completion requires an admitted, execution-ready Ordo contract whose decisions the host authority authorizes, with provides and release.json compatibility unchanged from 3.14.0), 3.20.0 (echelon-current 1.26.0; attested completion through work finish, with provides and release.json compatibility unchanged from 3.16.0), 3.21.0 (echelon-current 1.28.0; the requirements-preservation gate, with provides and release.json compatibility unchanged from 3.20.0), 3.22.0 (echelon-current 1.29.0; compiled verification-plan admission through the input-document inbox, praxis inbox admit-plan, with provides and release.json compatibility unchanged from 3.21.0), 3.23.0 (echelon-current 1.31.0; process evidence in the work event log, praxis work evidence, and integration-contract checks, praxis streams check, with provides and release.json compatibility unchanged from 3.22.0), 3.24.0 (echelon-current 1.33.0; owner-authorized autonomous execution, praxis autonomy, and a starter praxis-validation workflow that runs once per ref with a concurrency group and a timeout, with provides and release.json compatibility unchanged from 3.23.0) and 3.25.0 (echelon-current 1.36.0, which the indy-init preset follows; the requirement catalog compiler, praxis requirements manifest compile and check, with provides, release.json compatibility and the installed scaffold unchanged from 3.24.0) are qualified as embedded upgrade --current targets from 3.7.2 and from each other; Praxis releases declare no echelon.repository-lifecycle contract, so each exact version is qualified here; 3.1.x remains qualified only for existing compatibility fixtures.

Qualified Registry-package lifecycle release. 1.0.1 is the Registry echelon-current selection and the default; 1.0.0 stays qualified as its upgrade source. 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1 is a planned upgrade --current transition: VE upgrade rewrites its managed .gitignore region to !.visual-engineering/, then verify --strict must pass.
